FOREVER YOURS is the first book in a spellbinding new romance series by Fiona Grace, #1 bestselling author of The Inn at Dune Island, whose books have over 10,000 five star ratings and reviews!
 
In small town Minnesota, Lexi Turner has big dreams of becoming a physical therapist for pro athletes. When she gets a chance to intern as the physical therapist for the college hockey team, the Aces, she sees her big chance.
 
But Lexi never expected to catch the attention of big-hearted team captain Noah—or the rebel star forward, Wes. 
 
Torn between compassion and seduction, how can she choose?
 
Prepare to be captivated by ALWAYS ASHVILLE, where a small town romance beckons, leading you to a charming setting replete with witty banter, heartfelt moments, and unexpected twists. It will steal your heart and have you reading late into the night. (This series has been revised and renamed from its original title, Ashville Aces.)
 
Future books in the series are now available!
